fields.headline: This week was a lot, and a 24-hour trip with my kid is what brought me back to *myself*.
Navigating the separation, fighting with insurance and my own stuff coming up hard. Grown-up life was pulling me in every *direction*.
Then twenty-four hours with my kid. Car jokes, a concert, zero agenda, just *being* together.
Singing next to my kid, my younger self showed up too. The version of me who still remembers how to *play*.
The hard week didn't disappear. Joy just got a seat at the table *too*.
What brought you back to yourself this week? Even something small *counts*.
